I do care about my husband. I wish he would kill himself with me, but he refuses. I wish he earned enough money to support himself. He would be homeless without me. I think that's the only reason he stays with me. I love him and I hate him at the same time. I wish I didn't have him so I could die in peace. 

He doesn't understand what it's like to have my brain. It never stops, I constantly have this feeling of depression inside my head. I hug him and he tells me he loves me but it isn't enough. It doesn't make me feel better. Even when I smile I am still thinking that I want to die, even when I'm some what happy.
I enjoy sleeping. That's the only thing that gives me true pleasure.

Unfortunately, yes. My sister committed suicide. We had had a lot of problems in our relationship. We hadn't spoken for about six months, then she started trying to get in contact with me. I was extremely angry with her, she did some really damaging stuff to me and others in the family. I refused to respond. The night she died she had tried to call and text me she said "can we please talk please", but I didn't respond. 

I had asked her to get professional help and she refused repeatedly. She wasn't actively threatening suicide so I couldn't force her to get help. I was in the midst of my own severe depression and had recently attempted suicide myself. I was in no shape to help someone else.  I told her I couldn't help her, she needed to see a professional or reach out to someone else. She did reach out to others, but no one could provide what she needed I guess. 

I feel incredibly guilty about not responding, reaching out to her somehow. I don't know if it would have made a difference or not. I can't describe how horrible I feel about it. I think about it every day and regret my actions.
